# Thresholds

Fixed thresholds are set in the YAML `params` header. Thresholds for **number of counts** and **number of features** are data-driven: for each sample they are set to median ± `r params$nmads` MADs of the log10-transformed metric, computed on the cells that reach that step. Filters are applied **sequentially** in the order below, so each step only sees the cells that passed the previous steps. Doublets, number of counts and number of features are filtered on **both** RNA and ATAC.

```{r thresholds}
# lower/upper of "MAD" rows are filled in at their filtering step
thresholds <- tribble(
  ~step,                ~modality, ~metric,             ~label,                    ~method, ~lower,          ~upper,                ~log,
  "TSS enrichment",     "ATAC",    "TSS.enrichment",    "TSS enrichment",          "Fixed", params$tss_min,  Inf,                   FALSE,
  "Nucleosome signal",  "ATAC",    "nucleosome_signal", "Nucleosome signal",       "Fixed", -Inf,            params$nucleosome_max, FALSE,
  "FRiP",               "ATAC",    "FRiP",              "FRiP",                    "Fixed", params$frip_min, Inf,                   FALSE,
  "Number of counts",   "RNA",     "nCount_RNA",        "RNA UMI counts",          "MAD",   NA,              NA,                    TRUE,
  "Number of counts",   "ATAC",    "nCount_ATAC",       "ATAC fragments in peaks", "MAD",   NA,              NA,                    TRUE,
  "Number of features", "RNA",     "nFeature_RNA",      "RNA genes detected",      "MAD",   NA,              NA,                    TRUE,
  "Number of features", "ATAC",    "nFeature_ATAC",     "ATAC peaks detected",     "MAD",   NA,              NA,                    TRUE,
  "Mitochondrial %",    "RNA",     "percent.mt",        "% mitochondrial UMIs",    "Fixed", -Inf,            params$mt_max,         FALSE
)

stopifnot(params$doublet_rule %in% c("either", "both"))
```

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Autosomes, X and Y in either naming style ("1"/"chr1"); excludes chrM/MT and scaffolds
is_main_chrom <- function(chroms) grepl("^(chr)?([0-9]+|X|Y)$", chroms)

# Rename UCSC-style seqlevels ("chr1", "chrM") to Ensembl style ("1", "MT") when
# `ref_chroms` (e.g. the fragment file chromosomes) use Ensembl names, and vice versa
match_chrom_style <- function(gr, ref_chroms) {
  ref_ucsc <- any(startsWith(ref_chroms, "chr"))
  gr_ucsc  <- any(startsWith(seqlevels(gr), "chr"))
  old <- seqlevels(gr)
  if (gr_ucsc && !ref_ucsc) {
    new <- sub("^chr", "", sub("^chrM$", "MT", old))
  } else if (!gr_ucsc && ref_ucsc) {
    new <- ifelse(old == "MT", "chrM", ifelse(is_main_chrom(old), paste0("chr", old), old))
  } else {
    return(gr)
  }
  renameSeqlevels(gr, setNames(new, old))
}

# TRUE if every threshold of `step_name` is met (NA values fail)
pass_thresholds <- function(md, step_name) {
  thr <- filter(thresholds, step == step_name)
  ok <- rep(TRUE, nrow(md))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(thr))) {
    x <- md[[thr$metric[i]]]
    ok <- ok & !is.na(x) & x >= thr$lower[i] & x <= thr$upper[i]
  }
  ok
}

# Fill in the bounds of the "MAD" rows of `step_name`: median +/- nmads * MAD of
# log10(metric). Rounded inwards, which gives the same filter on integer counts.
set_mad_thresholds <- function(thresholds, md, step_name) {
  rows <- which(thresholds$step == step_name & thresholds$method == "MAD")
  for (i in rows) {
    lx <- log10(md[[thresholds$metric[i]]])
    lx <- lx[is.finite(lx)]
    bounds <- 10^(median(lx) + c(-1, 1) * params$nmads * mad(lx))
    thresholds$lower[i] <- ceiling(bounds[1])
    thresholds$upper[i] <- floor(bounds[2])
  }
  thresholds
}

pass_doublets <- function(md) {
  dbl_rna  <- md$rna_dbl_class == "doublet"
  dbl_atac <- md$atac_dbl_class == "doublet"
  is_dbl <- if (params$doublet_rule == "either") dbl_rna | dbl_atac else dbl_rna & dbl_atac
  !is_dbl
}

# One pass/fail function per filtering step, in the order they are applied
step_pass <- list(
  "TSS enrichment"     = function(md) pass_thresholds(md, "TSS enrichment"),
  "Nucleosome signal"  = function(md) pass_thresholds(md, "Nucleosome signal"),
  "FRiP"               = function(md) pass_thresholds(md, "FRiP"),
  "Doublets"           = pass_doublets,
  "Number of counts"   = function(md) pass_thresholds(md, "Number of counts"),
  "Number of features" = function(md) pass_thresholds(md, "Number of features"),
  "Mitochondrial %"    = function(md) pass_thresholds(md, "Mitochondrial %")
)

# Book-keeping: cells in/out per step and the step at which each cell was removed
qc_steps <- tibble()
removed_at <- character()

filter_step <- function(obj, step_name, pass) {
  stopifnot(length(pass) == ncol(obj), !anyNA(pass))
  removed_at[colnames(obj)[!pass]] <<- step_name
  qc_steps <<- bind_rows(qc_steps, tibble(
    Step = step_name, `Cells in` = ncol(obj),
    Removed = sum(!pass), Remaining = sum(pass)
  ))
  subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[pass])
}

# --- Plotting -------------------------------------------------------------
status_factor <- function(pass) factor(ifelse(pass, "Pass", "Fail"), levels = c("Pass", "Fail"))
status_cols <- c(Pass = "grey55", Fail = "#D55E00")

status_scales <- function(status, aesthetics = c("fill", "colour")) {
  n <- table(status)
  labs <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", names(n), format(as.integer(n), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)), names(n))
  scale_colour_manual(values = status_cols, labels = labs, drop = FALSE, aesthetics = aesthetics)
}

# Histogram of one metric, coloured by pass/fail, with threshold lines
plot_metric <- function(md, status, metric, label = metric, lines = numeric(), log = FALSE) {
  lines <- lines[is.finite(lines)]
  p <- ggplot(tibble(value = md[[metric]], status = status), aes(value, fill = status)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 100, position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
    labs(x = label, y = "Cells", fill = NULL) +
    status_scales(status, "fill")
  if (length(lines)) p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = lines, linetype = "dashed")
  if (log) p <- p + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma())
  p
}

# Histograms of all metrics belonging to one filtering step, side by side
plot_step <- function(md, pass, step_name) {
  thr <- filter(thresholds, step == step_name)
  status <- status_factor(pass)
  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(thr)), function(i) {
    plot_metric(md, status, thr$metric[i], thr$label[i],
                c(thr$lower[i], thr$upper[i]), thr$log[i])
  })
  wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
}

# Scatter of two metrics, failing cells drawn on top
plot_scatter <- function(md, status, x, y, xlab = x, ylab = y, logx = FALSE, logy = FALSE) {
  d <- tibble(x = md[[x]], y = md[[y]], status = status) |> arrange(status)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x, y, colour = status)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, colour = NULL) +
    status_scales(status, "colour") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1)))
  if (logx) p <- p + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma())
  if (logy) p <- p + scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma())
  p
}

# Facet label for one cutoff, e.g. "TSS enrichment ≥ 2 (applied)\nPass n = 900, Fail n = 100"
cutoff_label <- function(metric_label, op, cutoff, applied, pass) {
  sprintf("%s %s %s%s\nPass n = %s, Fail n = %s", metric_label, op, cutoff,
          if (cutoff == applied) " (applied)" else "",
          format(sum(pass), big.mark = ","), format(sum(!pass), big.mark = ","))
}

# Mean normalised Tn5 insertion signal +/- 1 kb around TSSs, for cells passing and
# failing TSS enrichment >= each cutoff. `tss_mat`: cells x positions matrix from
# TSSEnrichment(fast = FALSE); `score`: TSS enrichment of the same cells.
plot_tss_profiles <- function(tss_mat, score, cutoffs, applied, smooth = 11) {
  profiles <- bind_rows(lapply(cutoffs, function(cutoff) {
    pass <- score >= cutoff
    label <- cutoff_label("TSS enrichment", "≥", cutoff, applied, pass)
    bind_rows(lapply(c(TRUE, FALSE), function(p) {
      if (!any(pass == p)) return(NULL)
      signal <- colMeans(tss_mat[pass == p, , drop = FALSE])
      tibble(cutoff = label, status = if (p) "Pass" else "Fail",
             position = seq_along(signal) - (length(signal) + 1) / 2,
             signal = as.numeric(stats::filter(signal, rep(1 / smooth, smooth), sides = 2)))
    }))
  })) |>
    mutate(cutoff = factor(cutoff, levels = unique(cutoff)),
           status = factor(status, levels = c("Pass", "Fail")))
  ggplot(profiles, aes(position, signal, colour = status)) +
    geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~cutoff, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = status_cols) +
    labs(x = "Distance from TSS (bp)", y = "Mean normalised insertion signal", colour = NULL)
}

# Lengths of all fragments in `region` that belong to `cells`
read_fragment_lengths <- function(path, region, cells) {
  lines <- Rsamtools::scanTabix(path, param = region)[[1]]
  if (!length(lines)) stop("No fragments found in ", as.character(region))
  frags <- data.table::fread(text = lines, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", select = 2:4,
                             col.names = c("start", "end", "cell"))
  frags <- frags[frags$cell %in% cells, ]
  tibble(cell = frags$cell, length = frags$end - frags$start)
}

# Fragment size distribution (fraction of fragments per 5-bp bin) for cells
# passing and failing nucleosome signal <= each cutoff. `score` is named by cell.
plot_fragment_sizes <- function(frags, score, cutoffs, applied, max_length = 800, binwidth = 5) {
  frags <- frags |>
    filter(length <= max_length) |>
    mutate(bin = floor(length / binwidth) * binwidth, score = score[cell])
  sizes <- bind_rows(lapply(cutoffs, function(cutoff) {
    label <- cutoff_label("Nucleosome signal", "≤", cutoff, applied, score <= cutoff)
    frags |>
      mutate(status = if_else(score <= cutoff, "Pass", "Fail")) |>
      count(status, bin) |>
      group_by(status) |>
      mutate(fraction = n / sum(n), cutoff = label) |>
      ungroup()
  })) |>
    mutate(cutoff = factor(cutoff, levels = unique(cutoff)),
           status = factor(status, levels = c("Pass", "Fail")))
  ggplot(sizes, aes(bin, fraction, colour = status)) +
    geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~cutoff, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = status_cols) +
    labs(x = "Fragment length (bp)", y = "Fraction of fragments", colour = NULL)
}
```

# Load data

Starting point is the set of barcodes called as cells by Cell Ranger ARC.

```{r annotation}
# Gene annotation from GENCODE (mm39) in the format Signac expects; cached because
# importing the GTF is slow. "transcript" entries are kept so that transcript 5'
# ends (TSSs) are part of the annotation. Stored with GENCODE (UCSC-style) names.
anno_types <- c(transcript = "transcript", exon = "exon", CDS = "cds", UTR = "utr")
anno_cache <- params$annotation_cache
annotation <- if (file.exists(anno_cache)) readRDS(anno_cache)
# Rebuild caches made before transcript entries were included
if (is.null(annotation) || !"transcript" %in% annotation$type) {
  gtf <- rtracklayer::import(params$gtf)
  gtf <- gtf[gtf$type %in% names(anno_types)]
  annotation <- granges(gtf)
  annotation$gene_name    <- gtf$gene_name
  annotation$gene_id      <- gtf$gene_id
  annotation$gene_biotype <- gtf$gene_type
  annotation$tx_id        <- gtf$transcript_id
  annotation$type         <- unname(anno_types[as.character(gtf$type)])
  saveRDS(annotation, anno_cache)
  rm(gtf)
}
```

```{r load}
counts <- Read10X_h5(cr_file("filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts[["Gene Expression"]], assay = "RNA",
                          project = params$sample)

# Peaks on the main chromosomes only (drops unplaced scaffolds, e.g. JH584295.1)
atac_counts <- counts[["Peaks"]]
peak_ranges <- GRanges(rownames(atac_counts))
keep_peaks  <- is_main_chrom(as.character(seqnames(peak_ranges)))
atac_counts <- atac_counts[keep_peaks, ]
peak_ranges <- peak_ranges[keep_peaks]
rm(counts)

# Cell Ranger ARC references built from Ensembl name chromosomes "1", "X", "MT",
# whereas GENCODE uses "chr1", "chrX", "chrM". Rename the annotation to match the
# fragments file, otherwise no TSS is found in the fragments and TSS enrichment
# is 0 for every cell.
frag_path   <- cr_file("atac_fragments.tsv.gz")
frag_chroms <- Rsamtools::headerTabix(frag_path)$seqnames
annotation  <- match_chrom_style(annotation, frag_chroms)
annotation  <- keepSeqlevels(annotation, intersect(seqlevels(annotation), frag_chroms),
                             pruning.mode = "coarse")
annotation  <- annotation[is_main_chrom(as.character(seqnames(annotation)))]
stopifnot("No annotation chromosomes match the fragments file" = length(annotation) > 0)

obj[["ATAC"]] <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts     = atac_counts,
  ranges     = peak_ranges,
  fragments  = frag_path,
  annotation = annotation
)

obj$nCount_ATAC   <- Matrix::colSums(atac_counts)
obj$nFeature_ATAC <- Matrix::colSums(atac_counts > 0)
rm(atac_counts)

cat("Cell Ranger ARC cell calls:", ncol(obj), "\n")
cat("Fragment file chromosomes:", paste(head(frag_chroms, 25), collapse = " "), "\n")
```

```{r tss-positions}
# One TSS per protein-coding gene: the 5' end of the gene's outermost transcript
# (strand-aware). Passed to TSSEnrichment() explicitly, so the TSSs do not depend
# on how the Signac version derives them from the annotation.
tx <- annotation[annotation$type == "transcript" & annotation$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"]
tss_positions <- unlist(range(split(tx, tx$gene_id)))
tss_positions <- resize(tss_positions, width = 1, fix = "start")
rm(tx)

tss_found <- mean(as.character(seqnames(tss_positions)) %in% frag_chroms)
cat("Protein-coding TSSs:", length(tss_positions),
    sprintf("(%.1f%% on chromosomes present in the fragments file)\n", 100 * tss_found))
stopifnot("TSS chromosomes do not match the fragments file" = tss_found > 0.9)
```

# Compute QC metrics

```{r metrics-rna}
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^mt-")
```

```{r metrics-atac}
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "ATAC"
# NucleosomeSignal() and TSSEnrichment() are deprecated in Signac >= 1.17 in favour
# of ATACqc(), which needs the external `fragtk` binary. They still compute the
# same metrics, so the deprecation warnings are silenced.
obj <- suppressWarnings(NucleosomeSignal(obj))
# fast = FALSE also stores the per-cell signal +/- 1 kb around TSSs, used for the
# TSS profile plots (same TSS.enrichment score as fast = TRUE)
obj <- suppressWarnings(TSSEnrichment(obj, tss.positions = tss_positions, fast = FALSE))
stopifnot("TSS enrichment is 0 for all cells: check chromosome names" =
            any(obj$TSS.enrichment > 0))

# Keep the cells x positions matrix (dropping its "expected"/"motif" rows) and
# remove it from the object so the saved object stays small
tss_mat <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "ATAC", layer = "positionEnrichment")[["TSS"]]
tss_mat <- tss_mat[colnames(obj), , drop = FALSE]
obj@assays$ATAC@positionEnrichment <- list()

# FRiP from Cell Ranger ARC per-barcode metrics
pbm <- read_csv(cr_file("per_barcode_metrics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
idx <- match(colnames(obj), pbm$barcode)
obj$atac_fragments <- pbm$atac_fragments[idx]
obj$FRiP <- pbm$atac_peak_region_fragments[idx] / pbm$atac_fragments[idx]
```

## Doublet scores (RNA and ATAC)

Doublets are scored with `scDblFinder` independently on each modality, on all Cell Ranger cell calls (before any other filtering), so that the simulated doublets reflect the full cell population. For ATAC the recommended settings (`aggregateFeatures = TRUE`, `processing = "normFeatures"`) are used. The scores are used at the *Doublets* filtering step below.

```{r doublets}
sce_rna <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts = LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")))
sce_rna <- scDblFinder(sce_rna)
obj$rna_dbl_score <- sce_rna$scDblFinder.score
obj$rna_dbl_class <- as.character(sce_rna$scDblFinder.class)

sce_atac <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts = LayerData(obj, assay = "ATAC", layer = "counts")))
sce_atac <- scDblFinder(sce_atac, artificialDoublets = 1, aggregateFeatures = TRUE,
                        nfeatures = 25, processing = "normFeatures")
obj$atac_dbl_score <- sce_atac$scDblFinder.score
obj$atac_dbl_class <- as.character(sce_atac$scDblFinder.class)
rm(sce_rna, sce_atac)

DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
```

## Overview before filtering

```{r overview}
md0 <- obj[[]]
removed_at <- setNames(rep(NA_character_, ncol(obj)), colnames(obj))
qc_steps <- tibble(Step = "Cell Ranger ARC cell calls", `Cells in` = NA_integer_,
                   Removed = NA_integer_, Remaining = ncol(obj))

md0 |>
  select(all_of(unique(thresholds$metric)), rna_dbl_score, atac_dbl_score) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Metric") |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(Min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE), Q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            Median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), Q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            Max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  kable(digits = 2, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "QC metrics of all Cell Ranger cell calls")
```

# Sequential filtering

## 1. TSS enrichment

Keep cells with TSS enrichment ≥ `r params$tss_min`. The plot shows the mean normalised Tn5 insertion signal ±1 kb around protein-coding TSSs for cells that pass and fail at the applied threshold and at the other cutoffs in `params$tss_plot_cutoffs`. Passing cells should show a sharp peak at the TSS; failing cells a flat profile.

```{r step-tss, fig.height = 4.5, fig.width = 14}
md <- obj[[]]
pass <- step_pass[["TSS enrichment"]](md)
plot_tss_profiles(tss_mat[rownames(md), , drop = FALSE], md$TSS.enrichment,
                  cutoffs = sort(unique(c(params$tss_plot_cutoffs, params$tss_min))),
                  applied = params$tss_min)
obj <- filter_step(obj, "TSS enrichment", pass)
rm(tss_mat)
```

## 2. Nucleosome signal

Keep cells with nucleosome signal ≤ `r params$nucleosome_max`. The plot shows the fragment size distribution of cells that pass and fail at the applied threshold and at the other cutoffs in `params$nucleosome_plot_cutoffs`. Good-quality nuclei show a nucleosome-free peak (< 147 bp) followed by mono- and di-nucleosome peaks; a high nucleosome signal means relatively more mono-nucleosome fragments. Fragments are read from the first 30 Mb of chromosome 1, which is plenty for a per-group distribution.

```{r step-nucleosome, fig.height = 4.5, fig.width = 14}
md <- obj[[]]
pass <- step_pass[["Nucleosome signal"]](md)

frag_region <- GRanges(paste0(intersect(c("1", "chr1"), frag_chroms)[1], ":1-30000000"))
frag_lengths <- read_fragment_lengths(frag_path, frag_region, rownames(md))
plot_fragment_sizes(frag_lengths, setNames(md$nucleosome_signal, rownames(md)),
                    cutoffs = sort(unique(c(params$nucleosome_plot_cutoffs, params$nucleosome_max))),
                    applied = params$nucleosome_max)
obj <- filter_step(obj, "Nucleosome signal", pass)
rm(frag_lengths)
```

## 3. FRiP

Keep cells with fraction of fragments in peaks ≥ `r params$frip_min`.

```{r step-frip}
md <- obj[[]]
pass <- step_pass[["FRiP"]](md)
plot_step(md, pass, "FRiP")
obj <- filter_step(obj, "FRiP", pass)
```

## 4. Doublets (RNA + ATAC)

Remove cells called a doublet in **`r params$doublet_rule`** modality(ies) by `scDblFinder` (*Fail* = doublet). The plots show counts against features in each modality, to check whether doublets also carry more counts and features.

```{r step-doublets, fig.height = 5}
md <- obj[[]]
pass <- step_pass[["Doublets"]](md)
status <- status_factor(pass)

md |>
  mutate(Call = case_when(
    rna_dbl_class == "doublet" & atac_dbl_class == "doublet" ~ "Doublet in both",
    rna_dbl_class == "doublet" ~ "Doublet in RNA only",
    atac_dbl_class == "doublet" ~ "Doublet in ATAC only",
    TRUE ~ "Singlet in both"
  )) |>
  group_by(Call) |>
  summarise(Cells = n(),
            `Median RNA UMIs` = median(nCount_RNA), `Median RNA genes` = median(nFeature_RNA),
            `Median ATAC fragments in peaks` = median(nCount_ATAC),
            `Median ATAC peaks` = median(nFeature_ATAC)) |>
  kable(digits = 0, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
        caption = "scDblFinder calls per modality, with median counts and features")

p_rna <- plot_scatter(md, status, "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA",
                      "RNA UMI counts", "RNA genes detected", logx = TRUE, logy = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("RNA")
p_atac <- plot_scatter(md, status, "nCount_ATAC", "nFeature_ATAC",
                       "ATAC fragments in peaks", "ATAC peaks detected", logx = TRUE, logy = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("ATAC")
p_rna + p_atac + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
obj <- filter_step(obj, "Doublets", pass)
```

## 5. Number of counts (RNA + ATAC)

Keep cells within median ± `r params$nmads` MADs of log10(count) in **both** RNA (UMIs) and ATAC (fragments in peaks). Thresholds are computed on the cells remaining after the previous steps.

```{r step-counts}
md <- obj[[]]
thresholds <- set_mad_thresholds(thresholds, md, "Number of counts")
filter(thresholds, step == "Number of counts") |>
  select(Modality = modality, Metric = label, Lower = lower, Upper = upper) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "MAD-based thresholds")

pass <- step_pass[["Number of counts"]](md)
plot_step(md, pass, "Number of counts")
obj <- filter_step(obj, "Number of counts", pass)
```

## 6. Number of features (RNA + ATAC)

Keep cells within median ± `r params$nmads` MADs of log10(features) in **both** RNA (genes detected) and ATAC (peaks detected). Thresholds are computed on the cells remaining after the previous steps.

```{r step-features}
md <- obj[[]]
thresholds <- set_mad_thresholds(thresholds, md, "Number of features")
filter(thresholds, step == "Number of features") |>
  select(Modality = modality, Metric = label, Lower = lower, Upper = upper) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "MAD-based thresholds")

pass <- step_pass[["Number of features"]](md)
plot_step(md, pass, "Number of features")
obj <- filter_step(obj, "Number of features", pass)
```

## 7. Mitochondrial RNA

Keep cells with ≤ `r params$mt_max`% of RNA UMIs from mitochondrial genes (`^mt-`).

```{r step-mt}
md <- obj[[]]
pass <- step_pass[["Mitochondrial %"]](md)
plot_step(md, pass, "Mitochondrial %")
obj <- filter_step(obj, "Mitochondrial %", pass)
```

## 8. Ambient RNA correction (SoupX)

SoupX corrects the RNA counts of the retained cells; it does not remove cells. The soup profile is estimated from the empty droplets in `raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5`, and the contamination fraction (rho) is `r if (identical(params$soupx_rho, "auto")) "estimated automatically with \x60autoEstCont\x60 using a quick RNA clustering" else paste("fixed at", params$soupx_rho)`. Uncorrected counts are kept in the `RNA_raw` assay; the `RNA` assay holds the corrected counts.

```{r soupx-run}
raw <- Read10X_h5(cr_file("raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))[["Gene Expression"]]
toc <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
tod <- raw[rownames(toc), ]
rm(raw)

sc <- SoupChannel(tod = tod, toc = toc)

# Quick clustering of the retained cells, needed by SoupX
clust <- CreateSeuratObject(toc) |>
  NormalizeData(verbose = FALSE) |>
  FindVariableFeatures(verbose = FALSE) |>
  ScaleData(verbose = FALSE) |>
  RunPCA(verbose = FALSE) |>
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE) |>
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8, verbose = FALSE) |>
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
sc <- setClusters(sc, setNames(as.character(clust$seurat_clusters), colnames(clust)))
sc <- setDR(sc, Embeddings(clust, "umap"))

if (identical(params$soupx_rho, "auto")) {
  sc <- autoEstCont(sc, doPlot = FALSE)
} else {
  sc <- setContaminationFraction(sc, as.numeric(params$soupx_rho))
}
soupx_rho <- unique(sc$metaData$rho)
cat("SoupX contamination fraction (rho):", round(soupx_rho, 3), "\n")

adj <- adjustCounts(sc, roundToInt = TRUE)
```

Expression of selected genes (`params$soupx_genes`) before and after correction, as log-normalised expression (log1p of counts per 10,000) on a UMAP of the retained cells. Each gene uses the same colour scale before and after. Ambient transcripts appear as low-level expression across clusters that should not express the gene, and should be reduced after correction.

```{r soupx-plots, fig.height = 3.2 * (length(params$soupx_genes) + 1)}
soup_genes <- intersect(params$soupx_genes, rownames(toc))
if (length(soup_genes) < length(params$soupx_genes)) {
  warning("Not in the RNA assay: ", paste(setdiff(params$soupx_genes, soup_genes), collapse = ", "))
}

lognorm <- function(m) {
  as.matrix(log1p(t(t(m[soup_genes, , drop = FALSE]) / Matrix::colSums(m) * 1e4)))
}
umap <- as_tibble(Embeddings(clust, "umap"), rownames = "cell") |> setNames(c("cell", "UMAP_1", "UMAP_2"))
expr <- bind_rows(
  as_tibble(t(lognorm(toc)), rownames = "cell") |> mutate(condition = "Before SoupX"),
  as_tibble(t(lognorm(adj)), rownames = "cell") |> mutate(condition = "After SoupX")
) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(soup_genes), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") |>
  left_join(umap, by = "cell") |>
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Before SoupX", "After SoupX")))

tibble(
  Gene = soup_genes,
  `UMIs before` = Matrix::rowSums(toc[soup_genes, , drop = FALSE]),
  `UMIs after`  = Matrix::rowSums(adj[soup_genes, , drop = FALSE]),
  `% cells expressing before` = 100 * Matrix::rowMeans(toc[soup_genes, , drop = FALSE] > 0),
  `% cells expressing after`  = 100 * Matrix::rowMeans(adj[soup_genes, , drop = FALSE] > 0)
) |>
  kable(digits = 1, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
        caption = "Selected genes before and after SoupX correction")

p_clusters <- ggplot(mutate(umap, cluster = setNames(clust$seurat_clusters, colnames(clust))[cell]),
                     aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2), ncol = 2)) +
  ggtitle("Clusters used by SoupX")
gene_plots <- lapply(soup_genes, function(g) {
  d <- filter(expr, gene == g) |> arrange(expr)
  ggplot(d, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = expr)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~condition) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(limits = c(0, max(d$expr, 0.1))) +
    labs(title = g, colour = "log1p\nexpression")
})
wrap_plots(c(list(p_clusters), gene_plots), ncol = 1)

obj[["RNA_raw"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = toc)
obj[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = adj)
obj$nCount_RNA_soupx   <- Matrix::colSums(adj)
obj$nFeature_RNA_soupx <- Matrix::colSums(adj > 0)
rm(tod, toc, adj, clust, expr)

qc_steps <- bind_rows(qc_steps, tibble(
  Step = "SoupX ambient RNA correction", `Cells in` = ncol(obj),
  Removed = 0L, Remaining = ncol(obj)
))
```

# Summary

## Cells removed at each step

*Removed* is the number of cells removed at that step given the previous steps; *Fail (independently)* is the number of the original cell calls that would fail the step if it were applied on its own.

```{r summary-table}
md0$removed_at <- replace_na(removed_at[rownames(md0)], "Retained")
independent_fail <- vapply(step_pass, function(f) sum(!f(md0)), integer(1))

n_start <- nrow(md0)
summary_table <- qc_steps |>
  mutate(`Fail (independently)` = unname(independent_fail[Step]),
         `% of input removed` = round(100 * Removed / n_start, 2)) |>
  bind_rows(tibble(Step = "Total", `Cells in` = n_start,
                   Removed = n_start - ncol(obj), Remaining = ncol(obj),
                   `% of input removed` = round(100 * (n_start - ncol(obj)) / n_start, 2)))

kable(summary_table, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
      caption = paste0("Cells removed per filtering step (", params$sample, ")"))
```

## Thresholds used

```{r threshold-table}
fmt_num <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
criterion <- function(lo, hi) {
  if (is.finite(lo) && is.finite(hi)) paste(fmt_num(lo), "–", fmt_num(hi))
  else if (is.finite(lo)) paste("≥", fmt_num(lo))
  else paste("≤", fmt_num(hi))
}

threshold_table <- bind_rows(
  thresholds |>
    rowwise() |>
    transmute(Step = step, Modality = modality, Metric = label,
              Method = if (method == "MAD") sprintf("Median ± %s MAD (log10)", params$nmads) else "Fixed",
              `Keep if` = criterion(lower, upper)) |>
    ungroup(),
  tibble(Step = "Doublets", Modality = c("RNA", "ATAC", "RNA + ATAC"),
         Metric = c("scDblFinder class", "scDblFinder class (aggregated peaks)", "Combined rule"),
         Method = "scDblFinder",
         `Keep if` = c("singlet", "singlet",
                       if (params$doublet_rule == "either") "singlet in both modalities"
                       else "singlet in at least one modality")),
  tibble(Step = "SoupX ambient RNA correction", Modality = "RNA",
         Metric = "Contamination fraction (rho)",
         Method = if (identical(params$soupx_rho, "auto")) "SoupX autoEstCont" else "Fixed",
         `Keep if` = sprintf("rho = %s; no cells removed", round(soupx_rho, 3)))
) |>
  mutate(Step = factor(Step, levels = c(names(step_pass), "SoupX ambient RNA correction"))) |>
  arrange(Step) |>
  mutate(Step = as.character(Step))

kable(threshold_table, caption = paste0("Filtering thresholds (", params$sample, ")"))
```

# Save outputs

```{r save}
saveRDS(obj, out_file("qc_filtered.rds"))
write_csv(mutate(summary_table, Sample = params$sample, .before = 1), out_file("qc_cells_removed.csv"))
write_csv(mutate(threshold_table, Sample = params$sample, .before = 1), out_file("qc_thresholds.csv"))
write_csv(rownames_to_column(md0, "barcode"), out_file("qc_metrics_all_cells.csv"))
```
